blocks.html: NCP Holdings, L.P. (“NCP”), founded in 2005 by Lee Schear, is the holding company of NCP Finance and affiliated entities. NCP Finance or its affiliates originate a variety of consumer loans including installment, title and short-term cash advances brokered by their Credit Service Organizations (“CSO”) partners in the state of Texas under NCP’s CSO Program. CSOs are credit access businesses that provide consumers with assistance with repairing their credit and/or obtaining a loan in exchange for a fee. NCP originates and finds loans brokered by a network comprised of some of the most reputable and larger consumer finance companies in Texas.

blocks.text: BP PMKN LLC (“BP PMKN”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of BasePoint Capital III LLC, has agreed to acquire International Personal Finance plc (“IPF”), a British financial services provider operating in nine markets across Eastern Europe, Mexico and Australia. BP PMKN Eurobond represents cash collateral deposited into escrow in advance of the acquisition.

blocks.html: In December 2025, BP PMKN LLC (“BP PMKN”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of BasePoint Capital III LLC, provided interim bridge financing (the “Bridge Financing”) to its wholly owned acquisition vehicle, IPF Parent Holdings Limited (“UK Bidco”) for the pending acquisition of IPF. Under the UK Takeover Code, a bidder must demonstrate that it has suﬃcient financial resources to implement the oﬀer by the time a firm intention to make an oﬀer is announced. This UK process of a deal’s “cash confirmation” is typically satisfied through committed financing arrangements from banks or other institutions or by having funds readily available (for example, cash on hand or placed in escrow). To satisfy these requirements, BP PMKN funded an escrow account on behalf of UK Bidco in the amount of $549,602,200 to satisfy “cash confirmation” requirements. The funding was documented through two instruments (i) a $274,801,100 USD- denominated note issued by UK Bidco (the “Eurobond”) and (ii) a $274,801,100 secured promissory note issued by BP PMKN. BasePoint expects to refinance the Bridge Financing in full at or shortly prior to the closing of the acquisition. The Fund will have the option, but will not be obligated, to participate in the permanent financing of the acquisition. If the acquisition does not close, the funds in the escrow account will be released from the escrow account and returned to BP PMKN.

blocks.html: Landing, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Birmingham, AL, offers fully furnished, flexible-lease apartments for Landing members and corporate clients. Landing has built a nationwide network with apartments in 375 cities. For an annual membership fee, Landing members can access, and reserve fully-furnished one and two-bedroom apartments in urban centers throughout the United States. In March 2024, Landing completed an acquisition of the assets of Barsala, a platform that offers flexible, quick lease-up options to multi-family buildings owners and offers furnished, flexible term leases to customers through its website.
